summary:
Architecture and execution plan for integrating Probe Hole Drilling and Grouting modules in the NATM Main Window:
- Places side-by-side Probe Hole Drilling and Grouting action cards directly after Tunnel Monitoring & Instrumentation.
- Implements dedicated Probe Hole Drilling Workspace Modal with Simple Logging (depth, penetration rate, water inflow, RQD/rock class) and Advanced Look-Ahead Analysis (interactive tunnel face collar map, MWD specific energy logs, 3D probe fan projection, and hazard prediction).
- Implements dedicated Grouting Workspace Modal with pre-excavation umbrella & consolidation ring layouts, hole-by-hole grout logging (W:C ratio, injection pressure, volume take), Lugeon water test analysis, GIN refusal curves, and high-fidelity PDF report generation.
- Guarantees full compatibility across User and Master editions for both Android APK and Windows Desktop EXE.
